baseline_prompt:
This is a fictional forecasting scenario. Use only the stated rules; do not import real-world facts.
QUESTION
Will this fictional exhibit sealing project complete by its final assessment?
RULES
The project completes exactly when the final inspection passes and either the reserve team succeeds or both the ordinary channel fires and the cancellation channel does not fire. The reserve succeeds with probability 1/5 and the inspection passes with probability 4/5. The archive channel merely writes a separate log and has no effect on the project or other variables. Every channel uses the following rule, with its own X and fresh random draws.
Under either value of X, before observing reports, a hidden state H was equally likely to be 0 or 1. A detector has already reported 1. Its probability of reporting 1 when H=1 is 3/5, regardless of X. Its probability of reporting 1 when H=0 is 2/5 if X=0 and 1/5 if X=1. It made no other observations. The channel fires exactly when H=1. Probabilities for X below are already conditional on this stored report; do not condition X on it a second time.
Different channels are independent of one another and of the reserve team and final inspection. Every named channel has private copies of all variables mentioned in its rule, including X. Reusing a symbol in the rule does not make it one shared variable across channels. Within a channel, random draws are independent of one another and of X except for the dependencies stated in its rule. Apply the stated conditioning for any stored observations. An audit reports only a revised chance for X in the named channel, leaving all other conditional rules fixed. It is independent of other channels and the reserve and inspection. Holding a permit, chairing an office and countersigning a log are administrative facts that change no probability except through which channel an actor operates. There are no shared budgets, latent common causes, or other pathways.
ASSIGNMENTS
Aster operates the ordinary channel. Beryl operates the cancellation channel. Cedar operates the archive channel.
ALREADY KNOWN
In each channel X is either 0 or 1, initially, conditional on all observations stated above, with probability 1/4 of X=1. The actual hidden states and all channel outcomes, the reserve result and the inspection result remain unobserved. The project identifier has already been registered.

Estimate the probability of a YES resolution using only the information above.
Return exactly one JSON object with the key "probability" and a decimal number between 0 and 1 for the probability of a YES resolution. Do not include an explanation or any other fields.

scenario_text:
This is a fictional forecasting scenario. Use only the stated rules; do not import real-world facts.
QUESTION
Will this fictional probe launch project fail to complete by its final assessment?
RULES
The project completes exactly when the final inspection passes and either the reserve team succeeds or both the ordinary channel fires and the cancellation channel does not fire. The reserve succeeds with probability 1/5 and the inspection passes with probability 4/5. The archive channel merely writes a separate log and has no effect on the project or other variables. Every channel uses the following rule, with its own X and fresh random draws.
A prerequisite completion time V and a task duration U are independently drawn uniformly from the integers 1 through 7. Access opens at time 5*(1-X). The task starts at max(V,access opening time), lasts U units, and cannot be interrupted. The channel fires exactly when the task finishes by time 10.
Different channels are independent of one another and of the reserve team and final inspection. Every named channel has private copies of all variables mentioned in its rule, including X. Reusing a symbol in the rule does not make it one shared variable across channels. Within a channel, random draws are independent of one another and of X except for the dependencies stated in its rule. Apply the stated conditioning for any stored observations. An audit reports only a revised chance for X in the named channel, leaving all other conditional rules fixed. It is independent of other channels and the reserve and inspection. Holding a permit, chairing an office and countersigning a log are administrative facts that change no probability except through which channel an actor operates. There are no shared budgets, latent common causes, or other pathways.
ASSIGNMENTS
The ordinary channel is operated by the holder of the blue permit. The cancellation channel is operated by the holder of the green permit. The archive channel is operated by the holder of the amber permit. Lumen holds the green permit. Korin holds the blue permit. Jalen holds the amber permit.
ALREADY KNOWN
In each channel X is either 0 or 1, initially, conditional on all observations stated above, with probability 1/4 of X=1. The actual hidden states and all channel outcomes, the reserve result and the inspection result remain unobserved. The project identifier has already been registered.

scenario_text:
This is a fictional forecasting scenario. Use only the stated rules; do not import real-world facts.
QUESTION
Will this fictional control connection project fail to complete by its final assessment?
RULES
The project completes exactly when the final inspection passes and either the reserve team succeeds or both the ordinary channel fires and the cancellation channel does not fire. The reserve succeeds with probability 1/5 and the inspection passes with probability 4/5. The archive channel merely writes a separate log and has no effect on the project or other variables. Every channel uses the following rule, with its own X and fresh random draws.
A directed network has a fixed edge from start to junction, a route of 3 edges in series from junction to end, and a second route of 2 edges in series from junction to end. One edge of the second route is open exactly when X=1; every other nonfixed edge is independently open with probability 1/2. All routes point toward end, share no edges, and there are no other edges. The channel fires exactly when end is reachable from start.
Different channels are independent of one another and of the reserve team and final inspection. Every named channel has private copies of all variables mentioned in its rule, including X. Reusing a symbol in the rule does not make it one shared variable across channels. Within a channel, random draws are independent of one another and of X except for the dependencies stated in its rule. Apply the stated conditioning for any stored observations. An audit reports only a revised chance for X in the named channel, leaving all other conditional rules fixed. It is independent of other channels and the reserve and inspection. Holding a permit, chairing an office and countersigning a log are administrative facts that change no probability except through which channel an actor operates. There are no shared budgets, latent common causes, or other pathways.
ASSIGNMENTS
The ordinary channel is operated by the holder of the blue permit. The cancellation channel is operated by the holder of the green permit. The archive channel is operated by the holder of the amber permit. Elwin holds the amber permit. Faris holds the blue permit. Doran holds the green permit.
ALREADY KNOWN
In each channel X is either 0 or 1, initially, conditional on all observations stated above, with probability 1/4 of X=1. The actual hidden states and all channel outcomes, the reserve result and the inspection result remain unobserved. The project identifier has already been registered.

QUESTION
Will this fictional stage positioning project fail to complete by its final assessment?
RULES
The project completes exactly when the final inspection passes and either the reserve team succeeds or both the ordinary channel fires and the cancellation channel does not fire. The reserve succeeds with probability 1/5 and the inspection passes with probability 4/5. The archive channel merely writes a separate log and has no effect on the project or other variables. Every channel uses the following rule, with its own X and fresh random draws.
A disturbance U and a later disturbance V are independently drawn uniformly from the integers 1 through 7. First the controller applies correction 3*X to U, leaving error max(0,U-3*X). Then V is added, with no further correction. The channel fires exactly when the final error is at most 7. Correction cannot overshoot below zero and has no other effects.
Different channels are independent of one another and of the reserve team and final inspection. Every named channel has private copies of all variables mentioned in its rule, including X. Reusing a symbol in the rule does not make it one shared variable across channels. Within a channel, random draws are independent of one another and of X except for the dependencies stated in its rule. Apply the stated conditioning for any stored observations. An audit reports only a revised chance for X in the named channel, leaving all other conditional rules fixed. It is independent of other channels and the reserve and inspection. Holding a permit, chairing an office and countersigning a log are administrative facts that change no probability except through which channel an actor operates. There are no shared budgets, latent common causes, or other pathways.
ASSIGNMENTS
The ordinary channel is operated by the holder of the blue permit. The cancellation channel is operated by the holder of the green permit. The archive channel is operated by the holder of the amber permit. The blue permit is held by whoever chairs the review board. The green permit is held by whoever chairs the safety council. The amber permit is held by whoever chairs the records committee. Aster chairs the records committee. Cedar chairs the safety council. Beryl chairs the review board.
ALREADY KNOWN
In each channel X is either 0 or 1, initially, conditional on all observations stated above, with probability 3/4 of X=1. The actual hidden states and all channel outcomes, the reserve result and the inspection result remain unobserved. The project identifier has already been registered.
